description: The decimal sequences 0.5000… and 0.4999… both have value 1/2; only the former is canonical.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ComparingSizes.decimal_half_example :
  (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.decimalValue fun n => if n = 0 then 5 else 0) = 1 / 2 ∧
    (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CanonicalDecimal fun n => if n = 0 then 5 else 0) ∧
      (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.decimalValue fun n => if n = 0 then 4 else 9) = 1 / 2 ∧
        ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CanonicalDecimal fun n => if n = 0 then 4 else 9
